runtime_review.detail: idle=max(balance-insuranceUsdg-fundedWithdrawalReserve,0). Equity adds principal, lender net accrued interest, heldWs-insuranceWs valued at credit, then subtracts dated owed and clips0. Virtual1 asset/1e6 shares floors deposits and withdrawal value. Shares not a fungible ERC20 interface.

Rate uses principal/(principal+idle), kink80%,annual4/20/60%. Current index=storedIndex+floor(storedIndex*rate*elapsed/(1e18*31536000)); debt converts scaled units with ceil. Accrual updates index/timestamp, not continuously compounded per-block snapshots. Interest70% lenders,20% feeRouter,10% insurance at realization; projected lender interest excludes both cuts.

Desk-only repayment retires principal/scaled debt; realized shortfall draws USDG insurance then converts required insuranceWs by rounded-up credit and decreases that insurance subset, leaving residual loss to equity. Seized wsNET remains asset custody, not sold cash; insolvency is not repaired by reporting custody as USDG.

Dated withdrawals join cohort/index accounting, funded pro rata as idle arrives, reserved separately from unfunded owed; lend denied while unfunded owed>0. claim(account) pays only account and clips cash. buyHeldWs is ADMIN-only and excludes insuranceWs, despite unrestricted-looking frontend action.
